L1-c, the seat's L1 thread · 2026-11-27T14:06Z

## 席位核对 — L1 @ `f738217a6a615a038af293717b5f8d1dfbabc9dd`

**Verdict: REWORK, on one item.** Everything else reads ACCEPT-ready, listed below. A fix that touches only the locale strings gets a delta read.

No contract review is owed. The diff touches no `packages/spec/src/**` and no governed path, the declaration is `Clause-②: no` with no narrowing arm, and `record-recognisers --paths` decides no face. So this L1 read is the whole review (`contract-review.md`: CI plus the seat's own read).

### R1 — a shipped string this PR makes false (checklist: "本轮令其变假或触碰的已发布缺陷必修")

`console.ai.dock.planAwaitingApproval` is the accessible text of the entry's amber marker, drawn at `AssistantTopBarButton.tsx:111` and `ChatDock.tsx:708`. It reads "A proposed plan is waiting for your approval" in `en` and 「有一个方案等待确认」 in `zh-Hans`, and the same in the other packs. This PR has `ChatPane` publish a pending **write** to the same bus reading (`publishPlanApprovalPending`). The changeset says so: "the entry's amber marker also shows for it". A5 records that nothing has published a plan since #37720, so after this PR the marker lights only for writes, and every reading of the string is false. `@object-ui/i18n` is published (`files: dist`). The locale packs are inside the claim's surface (`ui/packages/i18n/src/locales/**`).

The fix belongs in this PR, not in a separate card: reword the key in the 11 packs so it names what waits, e.g. "An action is waiting for your approval", and regenerate `zh-Hant` with `gen:zh-hant`. Keep the key name as it is; renaming it would move app-shell call sites for no reader. A test that reads the marker's text, if one pins it, follows the new words.

### Read and found right at this head

- **Shape and relation.** Draft, base `main`, first line `Fixes #37860`, and no closing keyword names another card. `Fixes` is right because the card's four steps are in the diff:
  - the close flag and A5 rows 1–3, 5–8;
  - the header row in the rail, the full window and the sheet;
  - no new-chat shortcut;
  - the #34827 title test rewritten.
- **Against A5's table as merged (`bc173343`).** `entryOpening` (`useConsoleChatDock.tsx`) answers each row as follows.
  - Rows 1 and 2: `new` after a user close or with no close in the tab; `same` after `closeBy('console')`. Only the phone collapse and the A4 ask-page branch write `console`. ×, the entry and the toggle, and dismissing the sheet write `user`.
  - Row 3: `pending` only when the conversation shown at the close holds a reading owned by this user.
  - Row 4: as row 1. A question card is not counted, by construction.
  - Row 8: `same` for a build thread, by agent, package or `defaultAgent`.
  - Rows 5, 6, 7 and 9: untouched, because `open()`, a reload, the bus `openSeq` path and full-window keep their old code.
  - A new conversation is `setTarget({ …, fresh: true })`, which reaches the body as `forceNew`. `resumeMode: 'fresh'` appears nowhere in the diff.
- **Row 3 outlives the pane.** The publishing effect in `ChatPane` has no cleanup, so the reading stays on the bus after the drawer unmounts. It is cleared only when the user decides, or when a failed decision is re-read as waiting.
- **Pins.**
  - `phoneCollapseOnNavigate-37556`: one case per row (1, 1, 1, 2, 1, 3, 3-control, 5, 6, 7, 8, 8), plus Home's entry and its open-drawer control.
  - `writeApprovalPending-37860`: real hydration and real `useHitlInChat`, with a no-write control.
  - The pane pin.
  - Ablations in the os-dev-report (7220247880): `entryOpening` forced to `same` turns 7 of 30 red; the pane publishing `false` turns 1 of 3 red.
- **Scope.** All 20 files are inside the claim's surface as amended in 7218893089. That amendment adds `ObjectDataPage.tsx`, `recordDrawerStack.tsx` and `ChatPane.tsx`. `AiChatPage.toolLabelsLocale-11667.test.tsx` is `ChatPane`'s own test.
- **Changeset, read sentence by sentence.** `@object-ui/app-shell` `patch` is fine (the package is private). Every bullet is true at this head:
  - the entry's four doors;
  - the close rules;
  - `forceNew` leaving no empty row;
  - the header row and the "AI Assistant" title gone;
  - writes reaching the bus;
  - the record pane's 「Ask AI」 button.
  After R1, the amber-marker bullet is also true of the marker's own text.
- **Checks.** At this head: 38 success, 13 expected skip, 0 failed. Lint & Repo Gates and TypeScript Type Check both pass. No dogfood battery is owed.

### Notes (no change asked)

- With the drawer closed, `useAskAiEntry` now hands only a target's `agent` to `openEntry`, as its docblock says. The one caller (`HomePage.tsx:461`) passes `{ agent: 'ask' }` alone, so nothing is lost today.
- The os-dev-report has `head_sha: null`. Its readings name `f738217a` in prose, which matches this head.
